description: The signed-in account's plan and credits: credits left and used, free and bought, the emails sent as they run low, automatic top-up, the packs on sale, the plan's limits, and the account page where the user tops up. A credit is one minute of a job running (export, import, analysis, create.*); editing and previews are free. At 0 credits new jobs wait until the user tops up on the account page.
name: account.get

account_url.description: The account page, where the user signs in to see their credits and top up; null locally

bought.description: Credits bought in packs, after refunds. They never expire

free.description: Free credits the account started with

left.description: Credits left; null when there is no cap. At 0, new jobs wait; editing and previews keep working

per_month.description: A given plan's credits each month; null otherwise

renews.description: When a given plan's credits renew (ISO time); null otherwise

used.description: Credits used: since the account began (pay as you go) or this month (a given plan)

export_short_side.description: Largest export, its short side in pixels; null for any

jobs.description: Jobs that run at once; more wait. null for no cap

packs.description: Credit packs on sale, smallest first; empty when credits are not bought

plan.description: local: a server you run yourself, with no credits. free: the free credits, not topped up yet. credits: pay as you go, has bought credits. enterprise, lifetime, staff: given plans whose credits renew monthly or have no cap

automatic.description: Whether a pack is bought on its own when credits left fall below `below`

card_saved.description: Whether a card is saved, so a top-up on the account page is one click

pack.description: The pack an automatic top-up buys

top_up.description: null on a plan that is not bought

warnings.description: The emails the account gets as its credits run down

at_credits.description: The email goes out when credits left fall to this

emailed.description: Whether it has gone out for the credits the account has now

title: Get account
